name: My Clips' Rename on the TV layout, as admin, over "clip-rename-probe Web C" and "clip-rename-probe Web E" (Web E renamed on My Bookmarks): the remote's OK on a row's Rename clip opens exactly one dialog with the focus in the name; a new name typed; the D-pad goes down to "Also rename the file", Cancel and Rename; OK renames, the focus back on the row, one dialog all along; Rename file's confirmation starts on Cancel, one ArrowDown reaches Rename file, OK renames the file.

steps.name: helpers
the probe's clips
steps.script: const r = {}; for (const n of ["Web C","Web E"]) { const c = await __c5.clip('clip-rename-probe ' + n); if (!c) throw new Error('no clip clip-rename-probe ' + n + ': the probe seeds it first'); r[n] = { id: __c5.k(c.Id), name: c.Name, file: c.Clip.FileName, state: c.Clip.State, outdated: c.Clip.IsNameOutdated }; } return r;

steps.name: helpers (on the page)
TV: C's Rename clip focused
steps.script: const b = __c5.btn(__c5.row(__vars.seed['Web C'].id), 'Rename clip'); b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b;

steps.name: count the dialogs from here (TV)
steps.script: window.__c5max = document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop').length; window.__c5obs = new MutationObserver(() => { window.__c5max = Math.max(window.__c5max, document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop').length); }); window.__c5obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true }); return window.__c5max;

steps.name: TV: one dialog, the focus in the name
TV: the D-pad left the field for "Also rename the file", still ticked
TV: the box at the label's size (the TV rule), 24 px at least
renamed (TV): the dialog gone, the row's title the new name
C on the server and the focus (TV)
steps.script: const c = await __c5.clip('clip-rename-probe Web C renamed'); return { file: c && c.Clip.FileName, where: __c5.where(), maxDialogs: window.__c5max };

steps.name: TV: the file renamed, one dialog all along, the focus back on the row's Rename clip (not BODY)
steps.assert: __vars.t3.file === __vars.seed['Web C'].file.replace('clip-rename-probe Web C [', 'clip-rename-probe Web C renamed [') && __vars.t3.maxDialogs === 1 && !__vars.t3.where.body && __vars.t3.where.row === __vars.seed['Web C'].id && __vars.t3.where.title === 'Rename clip'

steps.name: TV: E's Rename file focused
steps.script: const b = __c5.btn(__c5.row(__vars.seed['Web E'].id), 'Rename file'); b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b;

steps.name: count the dialogs from here (TV, Rename file)
